SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku,MAX(m.name) AS name,
  SUM(m.demand) AS demand,
  SUM(GREATEST(m.demand-LEAST(m.sent,m.demand),0)) AS shortage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN m.demand ELSE 0 END) AS sample_demand,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN GREATEST(m.demand-LEAST(m.sent,m.demand),0) ELSE 0 END) AS sample_shortage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.invalid=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_records,
  COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(m.invalid) AS invalid,
  0 AS missing_ship_date,0 AS unmatched_order,0 AS missing_trace,0 AS missing_ship_time
  FROM (SELECT fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code AS sku,
  MAX(belong_base) AS base,MAX(product_categ_name) AS category,MAX(pinxiang) AS item,
  MAX(new_material_name) AS name,MAX(need_qty_origin) AS demand,MAX(qtyshipped) AS sent,
  MIN(fromorderno_month) AS period_start,MAX(fromorderno_month) AS period_end,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 AND COUNT(need_qty_origin)=1 AND COUNT(qtyshipped)=1
    AND COUNT(fromorderno_month)=1 AND MAX(need_qty_origin)>=0 AND MAX(qtyshipped)>=0
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(fromorderno),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(new_material_code),'') IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code,belong_base,product_categ_name,pinxiang,
    new_material_name,need_qty_origin,qtyshipped,executeorderno,fromorderno_month
    FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi
    WHERE exp_flag='否' AND (order_qty_origin>0 OR need_qty_origin>0)
      AND (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)) cleaned
  GROUP BY fromorderno,cust_code,new_material_code) m
  WHERE m.period_end>=:gea_p1 AND m.period_start<:gea_p2
  GROUP BY m.base,m.category,m.item,m.sku) counted

    CASE WHEN SUM(invalid_denominator)=0 THEN SUM(change_denominator) END AS denominator,
    
    SUM(unknown_quantity) AS unknown_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(invalid_change) AS invalid
    FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,material_code,cust_name AS name,
    region_name AS region,province_region_name AS province,
    CASE WHEN invalid_line=0 THEN changed_quantity ELSE 0 END AS change_numerator,
    effective_qty AS change_denominator,invalid_denominator,invalid_line AS invalid_change,
    CASE WHEN invalid_line>0 THEN difference_qty ELSE 0 END AS unknown_quantity
    FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,material_code,cust_name,region_name,province_region_name,
    requested_qty,effective_qty,ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) AS difference_qty,
    changed,header_addtime,requireddeliverytime,locked,
    invalid_header,header_status,cancelled,detailstatus,is_stat,
    CASE WHEN changed>=locked THEN ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) ELSE 0 END AS changed_quantity,
    CASE WHEN invalid_header>0 OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR detailstatus<>10 OR is_stat<>'1' OR detailstatus IS NULL OR is_stat IS NULL
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_denominator,
    CASE WHEN invalid_header>0 OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR detailstatus<>10 OR is_stat<>'1' OR detailstatus IS NULL OR is_stat IS NULL
      OR (requested_qty<>effective_qty AND (changed IS NULL OR header_addtime IS NULL
        OR requireddeliverytime IS NULL OR requireddeliverytime<header_addtime
        OR changed<header_addtime))
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_line
    FROM (SELECT s.cust_code,s.cust_order_no,s.executeorderno,s.belong_base,s.material_code,s.region_name,s.province_region_name,s.cust_name,s.header_addtime,s.requireddeliverytime,s.detailstatus,s.is_stat,s.change_order_qty,s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,s.changed,h.invalid_header,h.status AS header_status,h.cancelled,
    COALESCE(s.change_order_qty,0) AS requested_qty,
    COALESCE(s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,0) AS effective_qty,
    CASE WHEN s.requireddeliverytime<=s.header_addtime + INTERVAL '7' DAY
      THEN s.header_addtime + INTERVAL '12' HOUR
      ELSE s.requireddeliverytime - INTERVAL '7' DAY END AS locked
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,d.requireddeliverytime,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.custchangetime AS changed
    FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d
    WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR d.belong_base=:gea_p900)
      AND d.header_addtime>=:gea_p1 AND d.header_addtime<:gea_p2) s INNER JOIN (SELECT h.cust_code,h.cust_order_no,h.name,h.region,h.province,h.created,h.delivery,
  h.invalid_header,h.invalid_lock,h.status,h.cancelled,h.changed,h.cancel_conflict,
  CASE WHEN delivery<=created + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN created + INTERVAL '12' HOUR
    ELSE delivery - INTERVAL '7' DAY END AS locked
  FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,
  MAX(region_name) AS region,MAX(province_region_name) AS province,MAX(cust_name) AS name,
  MIN(header_addtime) AS created,MAX(requireddeliverytime) AS delivery,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(header_addtime)=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(orderstatus)=COUNT(*)
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_order_no),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid_header,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT requireddeliverytime)=1 AND COUNT(requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid_lock,
  CASE WHEN MIN(orderstatus)=90 AND MAX(orderstatus)=90 THEN 90 ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN orderstatus<>90 THEN orderstatus END) END AS status,
  MAX(canceltime) AS cancelled,MAX(custchangetime) AS changed,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT canceltime)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancel_conflict
  FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,belong_base,
  region_name,province_region_name,cust_name,header_addtime,requireddeliverytime,orderstatus,
  canceltime,custchangetime FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
    AND header_addtime>=:gea_p1 AND header_addtime<:gea_p2) event_rows
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY cust_code,cust_order_no) h
  WHERE h.created>=:gea_p1 AND h.created<:gea_p2) h
      ON (CASE WHEN h.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',h.cust_code) END)=(CASE WHEN s.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',s.cust_code) END) AND (CASE WHEN h.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',h.cust_order_no) END)=(CASE WHEN s.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',s.cust_order_no) END)
    WHERE s.detailstatus=10 AND s.is_stat='1'
      AND (h.status<>90 OR h.status IS NULL)
      AND (s.change_order_qty IS NOT NULL OR s.dms_last_update_qty IS NOT NULL
        OR s.need_qty_origin IS NOT NULL)) amendment_lines) classified_details) sku_events GROUP BY region,province,cust_code) counted

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (WITH stock_plans AS (SELECT belong_base,material_code,MAX(product_item) AS item,MAX(material_name) AS name,
        COUNT(*) AS source_rows,CAST(MAX(the_date) AS CHAR) AS stock_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=16 THEN main_sales_plan_v1 WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=20 THEN main_sales_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=26 THEN roll_sales_plan ELSE next_month_sales_plan END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=16 THEN main_sales_plan_v1 WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=20 THEN main_sales_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=26 THEN roll_sales_plan ELSE next_month_sales_plan END)<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sales_invalid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=16 THEN transfer_out_plan_v1 WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=20 THEN transfer_out_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=26 THEN transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE next_month_out_plan END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=16 THEN transfer_out_plan_v1 WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=20 THEN transfer_out_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=26 THEN transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE next_month_out_plan END)<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transfer_invalid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=16 THEN main_sales_plan_v1 WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=20 THEN main_sales_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=26 THEN roll_sales_plan ELSE next_month_sales_plan END) AS sales_plan,
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=16 THEN transfer_out_plan_v1 WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=20 THEN transfer_out_plan_adj
    WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(the_date AS CHAR),9,2) AS INTEGER)<=26 THEN transfer_out_plan_roll ELSE next_month_out_plan END) AS transfer_plan
        FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d
        WHERE the_date=(SELECT MAX(the_date) FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE the_date>=:gea_p1 AND the_date<:gea_p2)
        GROUP BY belong_base,material_code), stock_batches AS (SELECT belong_base,material_code,MAX(material_name) AS name,NULL AS item,
        CONCAT(SUBSTRING(MAX(month_date),1,4),'-',SUBSTRING(MAX(month_date),5,2),'-',SUBSTRING(MAX(month_date),7,2)) AS stock_date,
        SUM(available_qty) AS available,SUM(live_qty) AS inventory,
        NULL AS aged,SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid
        FROM agents_scm_inventory_sku_data_d
        WHERE warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND warehouse_classify_name IN ('工厂成品仓','工厂外租库')
          AND month_date=REPLACE(CAST((SELECT MAX(the_date) FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE the_date>=:gea_p1 AND the_date<:gea_p2) AS CHAR),'-','')
        GROUP BY belong_base,material_code),
      stock_dictionary AS (SELECT material_code AS sku,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_categ_name)=1 THEN MAX(product_categ_name) END AS category,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT material_group_name)=1 THEN MAX(material_group_name) END AS item
  FROM agents_scm_material_in_out_summary_d GROUP BY material_code) SELECT COALESCE(s.belong_base,b.belong_base) AS base,COALESCE(s.material_code,b.material_code) AS sku,
      d.category,COALESCE(s.item,b.item) AS item,COALESCE(s.name,b.name) AS name,
      COALESCE(b.stock_date,s.stock_date) AS stock_date,s.source_rows,b.available,b.inventory,b.aged,s.sales_plan,s.transfer_plan,
      NULL AS daily_demand,
      b.inventory AS national_inventory,s.sales_plan AS national_sales_plan,
      CASE WHEN b.stock_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS national_stock_records,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS national_plan_records,
      COALESCE(b.invalid,0) AS national_stock_invalid,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows>1 THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(s.sales_invalid,0) END AS national_plan_invalid,
      CASE WHEN b.inventory IS NULL OR b.invalid>0 OR s.source_rows IS NULL OR s.sales_invalid>0 OR s.transfer_invalid>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM stock_plans s LEFT JOIN stock_batches b ON b.belong_base=s.belong_base AND b.material_code=s.material_code
      LEFT JOIN stock_dictionary d ON d.sku=COALESCE(s.material_code,b.material_code) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(s.belong_base,b.belong_base) AS base,COALESCE(s.material_code,b.material_code) AS sku,
      d.category,COALESCE(s.item,b.item) AS item,COALESCE(s.name,b.name) AS name,
      COALESCE(b.stock_date,s.stock_date) AS stock_date,s.source_rows,b.available,b.inventory,b.aged,s.sales_plan,s.transfer_plan,
      NULL AS daily_demand,
      b.inventory AS national_inventory,s.sales_plan AS national_sales_plan,
      CASE WHEN b.stock_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS national_stock_records,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS national_plan_records,
      COALESCE(b.invalid,0) AS national_stock_invalid,
      CASE WHEN s.source_rows>1 THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(s.sales_invalid,0) END AS national_plan_invalid,
      CASE WHEN b.inventory IS NULL OR b.invalid>0 OR s.source_rows IS NULL OR s.sales_invalid>0 OR s.transfer_invalid>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid
 FROM stock_batches b LEFT JOIN stock_plans s ON b.belong_base=s.belong_base AND b.material_code=s.material_code
      LEFT JOIN stock_dictionary d ON d.sku=COALESCE(s.material_code,b.material_code) WHERE s.source_rows IS NULL) counted

SELECT MAX(b.dt) AS day FROM dwd_scm_material_age_his b
      INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT warehouse_id FROM dim_bas_warehouse
  WHERE warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
    AND warehouse_classify_name IN ('工厂成品仓','工厂外租库')) w ON w.warehouse_id=b.warehouseid
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT warehouseid,month_date,
  MAX(CASE WHEN warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02')
    OR warehouse_classify_name NOT IN ('工厂成品仓','工厂外租库') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(belong_base),''))=1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM (WITH packet_source AS (SELECT region,province,cust_code AS customer,MAX(name) AS name,
    CASE WHEN SUM(invalid_change)=0 THEN SUM(change_numerator) END AS numerator,
    CASE WHEN SUM(invalid_denominator)=0 THEN SUM(change_denominator) END AS denominator,
    
    SUM(unknown_quantity) AS unknown_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS records,SUM(invalid_change) AS invalid
    FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,material_code,cust_name AS name,
    region_name AS region,province_region_name AS province,
    CASE WHEN invalid_line=0 THEN changed_quantity ELSE 0 END AS change_numerator,
    effective_qty AS change_denominator,invalid_denominator,invalid_line AS invalid_change,
    CASE WHEN invalid_line>0 THEN difference_qty ELSE 0 END AS unknown_quantity
    FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,material_code,cust_name,region_name,province_region_name,
    requested_qty,effective_qty,ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) AS difference_qty,
    changed,header_addtime,requireddeliverytime,locked,
    invalid_header,header_status,cancelled,detailstatus,is_stat,
    CASE WHEN changed>=locked THEN ABS(requested_qty-effective_qty) ELSE 0 END AS changed_quantity,
    CASE WHEN invalid_header>0 OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR detailstatus<>10 OR is_stat<>'1' OR detailstatus IS NULL OR is_stat IS NULL
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_denominator,
    CASE WHEN invalid_header>0 OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR detailstatus<>10 OR is_stat<>'1' OR detailstatus IS NULL OR is_stat IS NULL
      OR (requested_qty<>effective_qty AND (changed IS NULL OR header_addtime IS NULL
        OR requireddeliverytime IS NULL OR requireddeliverytime<header_addtime
        OR changed<header_addtime))
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_line
    FROM (SELECT s.cust_code,s.cust_order_no,s.executeorderno,s.belong_base,s.material_code,s.region_name,s.province_region_name,s.cust_name,s.header_addtime,s.requireddeliverytime,s.detailstatus,s.is_stat,s.change_order_qty,s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,s.changed,h.invalid_header,h.status AS header_status,h.cancelled,
    COALESCE(s.change_order_qty,0) AS requested_qty,
    COALESCE(s.dms_last_update_qty,s.need_qty_origin,0) AS effective_qty,
    CASE WHEN s.requireddeliverytime<=s.header_addtime + INTERVAL '7' DAY
      THEN s.header_addtime + INTERVAL '12' HOUR
      ELSE s.requireddeliverytime - INTERVAL '7' DAY END AS locked
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,d.requireddeliverytime,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.custchangetime AS changed
    FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d
    WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR d.belong_base=:gea_p900)
      AND d.header_addtime>=:gea_p1 AND d.header_addtime<:gea_p2) s INNER JOIN (SELECT h.cust_code,h.cust_order_no,h.name,h.region,h.province,h.created,h.delivery,
  h.invalid_header,h.invalid_lock,h.status,h.cancelled,h.changed,h.cancel_conflict,
  CASE WHEN delivery<=created + INTERVAL '7' DAY THEN created + INTERVAL '12' HOUR
    ELSE delivery - INTERVAL '7' DAY END AS locked
  FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,
  MAX(region_name) AS region,MAX(province_region_name) AS province,MAX(cust_name) AS name,
  MIN(header_addtime) AS created,MAX(requireddeliverytime) AS delivery,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(header_addtime)=COUNT(*)
    AND COUNT(orderstatus)=COUNT(*)
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_order_no),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(cust_code),'') IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid_header,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT requireddeliverytime)=1 AND COUNT(requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid_lock,
  CASE WHEN MIN(orderstatus)=90 AND MAX(orderstatus)=90 THEN 90 ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN orderstatus<>90 THEN orderstatus END) END AS status,
  MAX(canceltime) AS cancelled,MAX(custchangetime) AS changed,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT canceltime)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancel_conflict
  FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,belong_base,
  region_name,province_region_name,cust_name,header_addtime,requireddeliverytime,orderstatus,
  canceltime,custchangetime FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
    AND header_addtime>=:gea_p1 AND header_addtime<:gea_p2) event_rows
  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY cust_code,cust_order_no) h
  WHERE h.created>=:gea_p1 AND h.created<:gea_p2) h
      ON (CASE WHEN h.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',h.cust_code) END)=(CASE WHEN s.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',s.cust_code) END) AND (CASE WHEN h.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',h.cust_order_no) END)=(CASE WHEN s.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',s.cust_order_no) END)
    WHERE s.detailstatus=10 AND s.is_stat='1'
      AND (h.status<>90 OR h.status IS NULL)
      AND (s.change_order_qty IS NOT NULL OR s.dms_last_update_qty IS NOT NULL
        OR s.need_qty_origin IS NOT NULL)) amendment_lines) classified_details) sku_events GROUP BY region,province,cust_code), packet_numbered AS (
    SELECT region,province,customer,name,numerator,denominator,records,invalid,unknown_quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY region,province,customer) AS packet_position,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS packet_scope_total FROM packet_source
  ) SELECT FLOOR((packet_position-1)/64) AS packet_index,
    COUNT(*) AS packet_count, MAX(packet_scope_total) AS packet_scope_total,
    ARRAY_AGG(CONCAT(CASE WHEN packet_position IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(packet_position AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(packet_position AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN region IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(region AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(region AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN province IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(province AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(province AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN customer IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(customer AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(customer AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN name IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(name AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(name AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN numerator IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(numerator AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(numerator AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN denominator IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(denominator AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(denominator AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN records IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(records AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(records AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN invalid IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(invalid AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(invalid AS VARCHAR)) END,CASE WHEN unknown_quantity IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',CAST(LENGTH(CAST(unknown_quantity AS VARCHAR)) AS VARCHAR),':',CAST(unknown_quantity AS VARCHAR)) END)) AS packet_rows
    FROM packet_numbered GROUP BY FLOOR((packet_position-1)/64) ORDER BY packet_index) counted

      OR detailstatus<>10 OR is_stat<>'1' OR detailstatus IS NULL OR is_stat IS NULL
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_denominator,
    CASE WHEN invalid_header>0 OR NULLIF(TRIM(material_code),'') IS NULL
      OR detailstatus<>10 OR is_stat<>'1' OR detailstatus IS NULL OR is_stat IS NULL
      OR (requested_qty<>effective_qty AND (changed IS NULL OR header_addtime IS NULL
        OR requireddeliverytime IS NULL OR requireddeliverytime<header_addtime

      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS invalid_line

    CASE WHEN s.requireddeliverytime<=s.header_addtime + INTERVAL '7' DAY

      ELSE s.requireddeliverytime - INTERVAL '7' DAY END AS locked
    FROM (SELECT d.cust_code,d.cust_order_no,d.executeorderno,d.belong_base,d.material_code,d.region_name,d.province_region_name,d.cust_name,d.header_addtime,d.requireddeliverytime,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.change_order_qty,d.dms_last_update_qty,d.need_qty_origin,d.custchangetime AS changed

      AND d.header_addtime>=:gea_p1 AND d.header_addtime<:gea_p2) s INNER JOIN (SELECT h.cust_code,h.cust_order_no,h.name,h.region,h.province,h.created,h.delivery,

  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT requireddeliverytime)=1 AND COUNT(requireddeliverytime)=COUNT(*)
    THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalid_lock,

  MAX(canceltime) AS cancelled,MAX(custchangetime) AS changed,

  FROM (SELECT cust_code,cust_order_no,belong_base,

  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)

  WHERE (:gea_p900='' OR belong_base=:gea_p900)
  GROUP BY cust_code,cust_order_no) h

      ON (CASE WHEN h.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',h.cust_code) END)=(CASE WHEN s.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',s.cust_code) END) AND (CASE WHEN h.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',h.cust_order_no) END)=(CASE WHEN s.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',s.cust_order_no) END)
    WHERE s.detailstatus=10 AND s.is_stat='1'
      AND (h.status<>90 OR h.status IS NULL)

    d.belong_base,d.detailstatus,d.is_stat,d.product_item,d.is_virtual FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_d d LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT DISTINCT cust_code,cust_order_no,executeorderno,belong_base,1 AS header_present
   FROM agents_scm_execute_detail_hourly_d) seen ON (CASE WHEN seen.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.cust_code) END)=(CASE WHEN d.cust_code IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.cust_code) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.cust_order_no) END)=(CASE WHEN d.cust_order_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.cust_order_no) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.executeorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.executeorderno) END)=(CASE WHEN d.executeorderno IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.executeorderno) END) AND (CASE WHEN seen.belong_base IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',seen.belong_base) END)=(CASE WHEN d.belong_base IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE CONCAT('V',d.belong_base) END)

  MAX(CASE WHEN (CASE

  WHEN f.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') OR r.warehouse_classify NOT IN ('01','02') THEN 0
  WHEN f.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02') AND r.warehouse_classify IN ('01','02')
    AND f.pickup_point IS NOT NULL AND r.pickup_point IS NOT NULL
